R512.note: allowed_classes=false closes the RCE for the reported unserialize() call, but the stated contract requires rows written after a JSON migration to still load correctly - unserialize() on a JSON string fails, so post-migration carts would silently break (returned as false, not an array); the write-up incorrectly claims the fix 'preserves the existing wire format' without handling the JSON case at all.
